batch_lessons: ADT shows that recurring revenue must be translated through SAC, attrition, leverage and value-capture math before it deserves a quality multiple.
Strategic partners can validate a distribution channel without transferring enough economics to public shareholders.
ADT's odd-lot tender shows that contractual priority can create a cleaner payoff than a directional operating forecast.
Adriatic Metals shows that mining NPV can be broadly right while production timing and additional-funding assumptions are materially wrong.
ADTRAN shows that funded customer programs and order timing can be better short-horizon evidence than broad telecom TAM forecasts.
Addus is a right-stock/wrong-mechanism case: the integrated-care thesis failed, while non-core divestiture and core focus created value.
Addenda shows that an obvious high-quality compounder can be taken out before public shareholders realize the intended long reinvestment runway.
Advant-E shows that a dark microcap can remain cheap indefinitely without a credible realization mechanism, even if the underlying business is sticky and cash generative.
